newsitem.title: UK: UK panel criticises Triplex over Wm Cook letter.
newsitem.headline: UK panel criticises Triplex over Wm Cook letter.

text.p: Britan's takeover panel on Tuesday criticised engineering group Triplex Lloyd and public relations firm Citigate Communications for leaking draft of letter written to the Department of Trade and Industry regarding takeover target William Cook Plc.
"....Both Triplex Lloyd and Citigate are criticised," the panel said in a statement.
Several newspapers quoted from a letter on January 31 addressed to DTI asking it to look into discrepancies in trading forecasts Cook made in 1996 prior to a hostile bid launched by Triplex.
Triplex revised an earlier offer to 383 pence a share which has since been pushed away by a 425 pence-a-share management buyout offer made by William Cook's executive chairman Andrew Cook.
Newspapers published a report saying the DTI had been asked to investigate discrepancies between a trading statement given out by William Cook and information given to its bankers.

The takeover panel criticised Triplex and its public relations firm Citigate Communications saying: "It is reprehensible, as in this case, intentionally to leak to the press during an offer a letter which contained references to a piece of confidential information..."
Last week, British marketing and publishing firm Incepta Plc set terms for a proposed acquisition of Citigate for a total of 8.32 million stg.
